summary.text: Diane Torres-Velásquez, listed by Ballotpedia as Elizabeth Torres-Velasquez (also known as Diane), is a Democratic state representative from District 30 who has served since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an educator with a Ph.D. from the University of New Mexico.

paragraphs.text: Torres-Velásquez earned a Ph.D. from the University of New Mexico in 1988, and her career experience includes working as an educator.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong educator committed to social justice and equity, and cited leadership roles in university governance committees and community initiatives.
She took office on January 1, 2025, and for 2025-2026 is assigned to the House Education Committee and the Labor, Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
